description: This file declares the interface for the IGstDecryptorElementFactory class, which is responsible for creating GStreamer decryptor elements within the Rialto media server component. It includes method declarations for creating factory instances and decryptor elements, and references external classes such as IDecryptionService and IGstWrapper.

classes.name: IGstDecryptorElementFactory
classes.description: Interface class for creating GStreamer decryptor elements, providing methods to instantiate the factory and create decryptor elements.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of IGstDecryptorElementFactory, returning a shared pointer to the factory or null on error.

methods.name: createDecryptorElement
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a GStreamer decryptor element, given a name, a decryption service, and a GStreamer wrapper.
